A little about me

Curiosity with a purpose.

I am a first-year B.A. (Hons. with Research) Psychology student at Lovely Professional University, working towards a future in government forensic psychology.

My journey

I want to apply psychological knowledge to understanding criminal behaviour, investigations and justice-related questions. After my undergraduate studies at LPU, I aim to pursue postgraduate study at the National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU), with a focus on criminology and forensic psychology.

Beyond academics, I enjoy creative expression, sports and writing. I believe that learning about people requires curiosity, patience and an open mind.

“Understanding the human mind can help us understand the stories behind human behaviour.”
